about: Interface strings of Kathā mode (journey picker, verse moment, recitation, study hall). OWNER: kc-view. Rules: notes/sa-ui.md.

models.source: MW anvaya m. 'connection, association'; (in gram.) 'the natural order or arrangement of words in a sentence, syntactical connection'; a-stem without ṇatva like देव
MW pada-ccheda m. 'the separation of words (in a sentence)'; a-stem without ṇatva like देव
compound of MW sarala 'straight, upright, honest, simple' + artha m. 'meaning'; the usual name of a plain-Sanskrit paraphrase in school editions; a-stem like देव (ṇatva blocked by the dental th)
compound of MW abhyAsa m. 'repetition, exercise, discipline, use, habit; repeated reading, study' + zAlA f. 'a house, mansion, hall'; ā-stem like लता

katha.styleKatha.ctx: journey picker (New journey, Settings): the story-first style (Kathā)

katha.styleAbhyasa.ctx: journey picker (New journey, Settings): the practice style (every move a question)

katha.noteKatha.en: Story first: read the epic, and recite a verse to wield its astra.
katha.noteKatha.ctx: journey picker: what the story style means (shown under the picker)

katha.noteAbhyasa.en: Practice: every move asks a question, and wild foes wait in the grass.
katha.noteAbhyasa.sa: युद्धे सर्वदा प्रश्नाः। तृणे शत्रवः प्रतीक्षन्ते।
katha.noteAbhyasa.ctx: journey picker: what the practice style means (shown under the picker)

katha.autoRecite.ctx: toggle (New journey for Kathā, Settings, the cast panel's help): verses in battle recite themselves

katha.autoReciteSub.en: Verses recite themselves; you never pick a word.
katha.autoReciteSub.sa: श्लोकाः स्वयं वदन्ति। त्वं पदं न चिनोषि।

katha.tabPada.ctx: verse moment tab: the verse's words in verse order (pada-ccheda)

katha.tabAnvaya.ctx: verse moment tab: the words in prose order (anvaya)

katha.tabSarala.ctx: verse moment tab: the meaning in simple Sanskrit

katha.tabEn.ctx: verse moment tab (sa-en / en only): the verse's English meaning

katha.tapToSee.en: Tap to see it all at once.
katha.tapToSee.ctx: verse moment: hint while the prose order unfolds by itself

katha.hint.ctx: recitation line: a first-akṣara memory hint ({$a} = the first akṣara; the abbreviation sign follows it)

katha.coach.en: Listen to the line. Where a word is missing, tap the right one.
katha.coach.sa: पादं शृणु। रिक्ते स्थाने उचितं पदं चिनु।
katha.coach.ctx: recitation panel, the tutorial duel's first turn only: a one-line coach above the line (v0.4.3)

katha.echoBar.ctx: battle name bar of the tutorial duel (call and response, v0.4.3): between the reciter and Bharadvāja (a lesson, not a debate)

katha.recallCap.ctx: recitation panel caption (first three casts with a gap, every story language; v0.4.3: संस्कृतम् too)

katha.chips.ctx: aria label of the three word chips in a recitation

katha.hurry.ctx: aria label / tooltip of the reciting line (a tap hurries it)

katha.srCast.ctx: screen reader: one announcement when the gap opens ({$line} has the word 'blank' for the gap)

katha.srLine.ctx: screen reader: a cast with no gap, announced once as it starts ({$astra} = the astra's name, {$line} = the recited pāda)

katha.srBlank.ctx: screen reader: the gap in the recited line

katha.srMissed.ctx: screen reader after a wrong pick: the right word

katha.help.ctx: recitation panel: the ? help button / heading

katha.help1.en: The verse recites itself. Tap it to go faster.
katha.help1.sa: श्लोकः स्वयं वदति। शीघ्रं पठितुं तं स्पृश।

katha.help2.en: One word is missing: pick it with one tap.
katha.help2.sa: एकं स्थानं रिक्तम्। उचितं पदं चिनु।

katha.help3.en: A wrong word still works, with less strength.
katha.help3.sa: अन्यत् पदम् अपि किञ्चित् फलं ददाति।
katha.help3.ctx: recitation help, line 3 (a miss = half effect)

katha.studyHall.ctx: shrine menu option (Kathā only): five classic challenges

katha.fitTag.ctx: foe card (Kathā battle, v0.5a): the foe's affinity — the astra that fits it in Vālmīki (Mānava for Mārīca, Bāla 1.30.17), else the element strong against it; {$x} = that astra's or element's name (names.json stem, as on the move buttons)

katha.tired.ctx: move button (Kathā battle, v0.5a): this astra was cast last turn — cast again it lands weaker (× 0.6, then × 0.4); श्रान्तम् agrees with अस्त्रम् (n.)

katha.shield.ctx: battle panel (Kathā, v0.5a), shown when a foe has readied a great blow: the verse shield — recite a line of a heard verse, and the blow lands softly

katha.cover.ctx: battle panel (Kathā, v0.5a), shown when a foe has readied a great blow: a benched guardian steps in with this move ({$who} = the hero's name, nominative; {$move} = the move's name), one tap

party.moveMetaKatha.ctx: party (Kathā): a move's element and PP (no challenge kind: in Kathā only verse-bound astras ask anything)

katha.bookProgress.ctx: verse book (Kathā): how many of all verses the player has heard

settings.showWay.ctx: Settings toggle (both journeys, v0.4.2): a marker on the map points to where to go next (the next person, place, shrine or exit); दिश् = to point out, to show (दर्शय is not in the verified packs)

settings.showWaySub.en: a marker shows where to go next
settings.showWaySub.ctx: Settings: under Show the way — what the marker does (गन्तव्यं स्थानम् = the place to go)

bookEnd.title.ctx: book-complete screen (v0.5a) title, and the shell result's summary when one book was completed. {$book} = the book's name from names.json; in Sanskrit its form before a consonant (बालकाण्डम् → बालकाण्डं, anusvāra 8.3.23): बालकाण्डं समाप्तम्, as in a kāṇḍa's colophon

bookEnd.story1.en: You free Tataka's forest from fear and guard the sacrifice at Siddhashrama.
bookEnd.story1.sa: त्वं ताटकायाः वनं भयात् मुक्तं करोषि। सिद्धाश्रमे यज्ञं च रक्षसि।
bookEnd.story1.ctx: book-complete screen, book 1: what happened (the last two sentences of book 1's verified chapter summary, sa-dialogue-4)

bookEnd.story2.en: Rama goes to the forest. At Chitrakuta, Bharata accepts Rama's sandals.
bookEnd.story2.sa: रामः वनं गच्छति। चित्रकूटे भरतः रामस्य पादुके स्वीकरोति।
bookEnd.story2.ctx: book-complete screen, book 2: what happened (two sentences of book 2's verified chapter summary, sa-dialogue-4)

bookEnd.story3.en: Ravana carries Sita off. Shabari shows the way to Sugriva.
bookEnd.story3.sa: रावणः सीतां हरति। शबरी सुग्रीवं प्रति मार्गं दर्शयति।
bookEnd.story3.ctx: book-complete screen, book 3: what happened (two sentences of book 3's verified chapter summary, sa-dialogue-4)

bookEnd.story4.en: Rama and Sugriva become friends. Jambavan tells Hanuman, “Your strength is great.”
bookEnd.story4.sa: रामः सुग्रीवः च मित्रे भवतः। जाम्बवान् हनुमते वदति, “तव बलं महत्” इति।
bookEnd.story4.ctx: book-complete screen, book 4: what happened (two sentences of book 4's verified chapter summary, sa-dialogue-4, without अन्ते)

bookEnd.story5.en: Hanuman leaps over the ocean. He sees Sita in the Ashoka grove.
bookEnd.story5.sa: हनुमान् समुद्रस्य उपरि उत्पतति। सः अशोकवनिकायां सीतां पश्यति।
bookEnd.story5.ctx: book-complete screen, book 5: what happened (two sentences of book 5's verified chapter summary, sa-dialogue-4)

bookEnd.inBook.ctx: book-complete screen: heading over the three numbers

bookEnd.heard.ctx: book-complete screen: the first number (n / all of the book's verses)

bookEnd.heardWhy.en: Verses you met in the story. At a shrine, recite a heard verse to restore it.
bookEnd.heardWhy.sa: कथायां श्रुताः श्लोकाः। मन्दिरे श्रुतं श्लोकं पठ, पूर्णं कुरु।
bookEnd.heardWhy.ctx: book-complete screen: what 'verses heard' means and why it matters (a heard verse can be restored at a shrine; the second sentence follows shrine.reciteSub / shrine.reciteHead)

bookEnd.recited.ctx: book-complete screen (Kathā): the second number — recitation lines (pādas) the player said

bookEnd.recitedWhy.en: Lines you said yourself, in battle and at shrines. When you recite, the astra gains its strength.
bookEnd.recitedWhy.sa: युद्धे मन्दिरे च त्वया पठिताः पादाः। यदा त्वं पठसि, तदा अस्त्रं बलं लभते।
bookEnd.recitedWhy.ctx: book-complete screen (Kathā): what 'lines recited' means and why it matters (a recited cast fires the astra; title.howto3: अस्त्राणि … बलं लभन्ते)

bookEnd.restored.ctx: book-complete screen: the third number (n / all of the book's verses); पूर्णः = restored, as in title.restored

bookEnd.restoredWhy.en: At an āśrama shrine you recited all four lines of the verse. A restored verse sometimes gives a new astra.
bookEnd.restoredWhy.sa: आश्रमस्य मन्दिरे त्वया श्लोकस्य चत्वारः पादाः पठिताः। पूर्णः श्लोकः कदाचित् नूतनम् अस्त्रं ददाति।
bookEnd.restoredWhy.ctx: book-complete screen: what 'verses restored' means and why it matters (9 of the 21 verses unlock an astra; the screen's verse list names it)

bookEnd.answers.ctx: book-complete screen (practice journey): the second number — questions answered right / answered

bookEnd.answersWhy.en: Questions you answered right, in battle and at shrines. When the answer is right, the move gains its strength.
bookEnd.answersWhy.sa: युद्धे मन्दिरे च प्रश्नानाम् उचितानि उत्तराणि। यदा उत्तरम् उचितम्, तदा मन्त्रः बलं लभते।
bookEnd.answersWhy.ctx: book-complete screen (practice journey): what 'right answers' means and why it matters (a right answer = full power; मन्त्रः = move, notes/sa-ui.md glossary)

bookEnd.verses.ctx: book-complete screen: heading over the book's verses (first line, citation, state)

bookEnd.notHeard.ctx: book-complete screen: state chip of a verse of the book the player has not heard (shown as ???, like the verse book)

bookEnd.astra.ctx: book-complete screen: under a verse that gives an astra when restored ({$move} = {n:move.<id>})

bookEnd.next.ctx: book-complete screen, primary button: the story goes on into the next book in the same session ({$book} = the next book's name; Sanskrit: its form before a consonant, अयोध्याकाण्डं प्रति)

bookEnd.stop.ctx: book-complete screen, secondary button: end the session (the platform's result screen follows); अद्य अलम् as in menu.rest

bookEnd.resultBooks.ctx: session result summary (shell, संस्कृतम् reader): several books completed in one session ({$list} = 1, 2)

bookEnd.resultOpen.ctx: session result summary (shell, संस्कृतम् reader): no book completed in this session

bookEnd.resultHeard.ctx: session result summary (shell, संस्कृतम् reader, Kathā): verses heard this session (label style with the number after it, like title.restored)

bookEnd.resultRecited.ctx: session result (shell, संस्कृतम् reader, Kathā): recitation lines this session, in the summary and on a verse's review row

bookEnd.resultRestored.ctx: session result summary (shell, संस्कृतम् reader): verses restored this session

bookEnd.resultRight.ctx: session result summary (shell, संस्कृतम् reader, practice journey): right answers / questions this session
